notes.title: v1.2d is released.
notes.content:
[h3][h1]Fixed[/h1][/h3]
[list]
[*]Wage alert when there is no problem when the balance / wage cost.
[*]Error at match start when playing with a friendly match between user teams.
[*]Transfer list was not working.
[/list]

[list]

[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed long pass algorithm.

[*] Better goal net physics.

Enjoy v1.2d!

notes.title: v1.1b released.
notes.content:
[u]All current players are rewarded with[/u] [h3]50.000.000[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42883273/4877eab49687f255f78f30cb2d1d901467d0ab18.png[/img][/h3][h3]500[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42883273/907e4fafd44e700400f659f299f497bbc3095679.png[/img][/h3]

[list]
[*] Goal scoring can stuck the game if two footballers are blocking each other. Now the system is independent from goal celebration.
[*] Animation system throws error when quickly close the statistics panel.
[*] Beard, Hair, Face randomizer cards throws error and cannot be used.
[*] Sending you player to another team from transfer list screen breaks your team data. (Server bug).
[/list]
[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Date time to inbox messages.
[*] If you sell footballer on transfer list, the inbox message will contain a reward. (Server addition)
[/list]
[b]Match Engine[/b]
[list]
[*] Marking the last guy when attacking were not positioning properly.
[*] Passing algorithm renewed. Now we will see proper long passes.
[*] Footballers will better find position when GK is about to send the ball.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.1a released
notes.content:
[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] End of the match detailed statistics system.
[*] Live match statistics system, different details about the match for both teams & players.
[*] New Card: Vacation card, all of your teams will earn morale when you find this card.
[*] Better graphics [list]
[*] Anti-aliasing *
[*] Ambient occlusion on grass shader. *
[*] Motion blur *
[*] Better color correction *
[/list][/list] * (High graphics quality only)

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*]Calculation algorithm of footballer's overall & market value. Your players' overall may be increased/decreased when you age them.
[list]
[*]Now we are considering the footballer's field position to calculate the overall value.	
[*]Your footballers' skills won't be changed but overall & market value & wage will be changed.
[/list]
[/list] [b]Match Engine[/b]
[list]
[*] Better GK movement & diving algorithm.
[*] Improved short passes.
[*] Better long ball drop point prediction.
[*] Proper positioning when GK is about to kick the ball.
[*] New animations & proper animation speeds according the movement.
[*] Revamped Mark the last guy algorithm
[*] Better offside line protection.
[*] Adjusted settings to get deep short passes.
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Ageing and wage warning on uncompetitive matches.
[/list]

Known glitches
[list]
[*] At the end of the match, you may get an exception (error) from animation system. It's not a game breaker. You can close it and continue. It will be fixed in the next update.
[/list]

[*] Better long ball drop point prediction.
[*] Proper positioning when GK is about to kick the ball.
[*] New animations & proper animation speeds according the movement.
[*] Revamped Mark the last guy algorithm

notes.title: Upcoming update (v1.1a) and server relocation.
notes.content:
The game server will get down at 3 a.m. CET to let us relocate it to a new powerful cloud host from a turtle cloud host.

No user data will be lost in this process but the server won't be open until 6 a.m. CET.

The older clients won't be able to connect to this server version.
We will release the new version v1.1a (It's a huge update) when the new game server gets live. 

Thank you for your understanding!

tags.feature: - The older clients won't be able to connect to this server version.
- We will release the new version v1.1a (It's a huge update) when the new game server gets live.
